item.title: Monkey spotted during spring break visit to Silver Springs
item.description: A rhesus macaque rests in a tree at Silver Springs during spring break, where a well-known population of monkeys has lived for decades. Thanks to Jennifer Corrigan for sharing!

item.title: I think a train to connect Ocala would improve quality of life
item.description: "Why don’t we have a public train station in Ocala? I think it would allow Ocala residents to travel to different parts of Florida without the hassle of driving, especially for the seniors. The public transportation will also relieve the growing traffic. A train would improve the quality of life for Ocala residents and boost the city's economy because people will be traveling more and spending more. item.title: Ocala driver who fatally crashed into young mother's motorcycle on I-75 arrested for DUI manslaughter
item.description: An Ocala driver, who soiled her pants and registered a blood alcohol content level above the legal limit, is facing a charge of manslaughter while driving under the influence of alcohol after admitting to fatally rear-ending a 22-year-old mother's motorcycle on Interstate 75.

item.title: Two new storage facilities planned for Ocala, Summerfield
item.description: Plans for two new storage facilities totaling over 270,000 square feet were introduced to the Marion County Development Review Committee on Monday, with one project slated for southwest Ocala and the other for Summerfield.

item.title: Curious cattle spotted on outskirts of Ocala
item.description: Cattle stand in a pasture on the outskirts of Ocala, where rural landscapes stretch beyond the city’s edge. Thanks to Eva Hahn for sharing!

item.title: Ocala Skate Park celebrating expansion with Rodney Mullen this weekend
item.description: The "Godfather of Modern Street Skating" is coming to Ocala this Saturday to headline a massive grand opening celebration for the newly expanded skate park.

item.title: Ocala woman charged with attempted murder in stabbing of elderly man
item.description: An Ocala woman is facing an attempted murder charge after she allegedly stabbed an 83-year-old man multiple times with a knife on Saturday morning.

item.title: I believe the traffic problems in Ocala can't be fixed with one big idea.
item.description: "What we do have is a growing community with almost no meaningful public transit. Even SunTran, our only real option, was recently looking at reducing service because ridership is so low. That’s not a sign that people don’t need transportation. It’s a sign that the system we currently have isn’t meeting people where they are or offering routes and schedules that actually solve daily needs. item.title: Iconic horror film shot in Marion County remains area's biggest hit
item.description: In the 25 years since the production of Jeepers Creepers first descended upon the backroads of Marion County, the area's most commercially successful film has developed a cult following and cemented itself as one of the great horror films of its time.

item.title: Brenda Haydon
item.description: Brenda Haydon loved fishing with her family at the Barge Canal, spending time sewing and crafting, and shopping for bargains. Always looking for ways to give to others.

item.title: New Safe Haven Baby Box at Ocala fire station dedicated by Marion County officials
item.description: Marion County officials have christened another Safe Haven Baby Box to provide parents an anonymous option to surrender their newborns, just over five years after Ocala became the first city in Florida with one of the devices.

item.title: Roaches force Huddle House to temporarily close Ocala restaurant
item.description: An Ocala restaurant was forced to temporarily close its doors on Tuesday after a state health inspector found live roaches and flying insects on the premises.

item.title: Steven Allen Foust
item.description: Steven Foust was a quick-witted, lifelong animal lover, as well as an avid reader with a love for anything sci-fi. He enjoyed watching movies, spending time with his family and exploring new places.
